title: Privacy
description: Information about the current features and hosting of the QuickIris GitHub Pages website.

sections.heading: Current website features
paragraphs: This website does not currently display ads or include a separate visitor analytics script. It does not provide account registration or forms for submitting personal information.

sections.heading: GitHub Pages hosting
paragraphs: GitHub Pages hosts this website. GitHub's documentation states that it records and stores visitors' IP addresses for security purposes, whether or not visitors are signed in to GitHub.
For details about GitHub's handling of personal information, read the official documentation and privacy statement linked below.
